date.description: The date of the work, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

doi.description: The DOI of the published version.

identifiers.description: Other identifiers for this work, keyed by scheme.

open_access.description: Whether the published work is open access.

license.description: The licence, as an SPDX identifier -- `CC-BY-4.0` -- or a map with `content` and `code`.

binder.description: A binder URL the live site offers.

subject.description: The subject or section the work belongs to.

first_page.description: First page in the printed venue.

last_page.description: Last page in the printed venue.

numbering.description: What gets numbered and how: headings, figures, equations, and their formats.

bibliography.description: The `.bib` files the citations are resolved against.

math.description: Macros available to every equation, as `{ "\\macro": "definition" }`.

abbreviations.description: Abbreviations expanded on first use, as `{ SHORT: "the long form" }`.

exports.description: The documents built from this one: `pdf`, `tex`, `docx`, `typst`, each with its own options.

downloads.description: Files offered for download beside the page.

edit_url.description: A link that opens this page for editing.

source_url.description: A link to the source of this page.

subtitle.description: A second line under the title.

short_title.description: A shortened title, for running heads and navigation.

description.description: One or two sentences describing the document, used in listings and link previews.

thumbnail.description: The image that stands for the document in listings.

thumbnailOptimized.description: The optimized thumbnail, written by the build. Not usually set by hand.

banner.description: A wide image shown at the head of the page.

bannerOptimized.description: The optimized banner, written by the build. Not usually set by hand.

authors.description: The authors, as a list of names or of objects with `name`, `email`, `orcid`, `affiliations`.

venue.description: Where the work appeared: a journal, a conference, a series.

github.description: The repository the work lives in.

affiliations.description: Institutions the people above belong to, declared once and referenced by id.

funding.description: Funding and awards behind the work.

options.description: Template options, passed through to the site or export template.

parts.description: Named parts of the document -- `abstract`, `acknowledgments`, and any part a template asks for.

social.description: Social accounts shown with the work: `twitter`, `mastodon`, and the like.

abstract.description: The abstract, inline or as a path to a file holding it.

keypoints.description: The key points of the work.

epigraph.description: An epigraph printed at the head of the work.

label.description: An identifier this document can be cross-referenced by.

kernelspec.description: The Jupyter kernel the code cells run in.

jupytext.description: Jupytext metadata, kept when a notebook is paired with this text file.

site.description: Site-level frontmatter for this page -- normally set in `myst.yml` instead.

enumerator.description: An explicit number for this document, overriding the computed one.

content_includes_title.description: Whether the body already starts with the title, so it is not added twice.

skip_execution.description: Do not execute this document's code cells.

author.description: Alias of `authors`. The authors, as a list of names or of objects with `name`, `email`, `orcid`, `affiliations`.

reviewer.description: Alias of `reviewers`. The reviewers of the work.

editor.description: Alias of `editors`. The editors of the work.

contributor.description: Alias of `contributors`. People credited without being authors.

affiliation.description: Alias of `affiliations`. Institutions the people above belong to, declared once and referenced by id.

export.description: Alias of `exports`. The documents built from this one: `pdf`, `tex`, `docx`, `typst`, each with its own options.

download.description: Alias of `downloads`. Files offered for download beside the page.

part.description: Alias of `parts`. Named parts of the document -- `abstract`, `acknowledgments`, and any part a template asks for.

quote.description: Alias of `epigraph`. An epigraph printed at the head of the work.

keyPoints.description: Alias of `keypoints`. The key points of the work.

key_points.description: Alias of `keypoints`. The key points of the work.

key-points.description: Alias of `keypoints`. The key points of the work.

image.description: Alias of `thumbnail`. The image that stands for the document in listings.

identifier.description: Alias of `identifiers`. Other identifiers for this work, keyed by scheme.

socials.description: Alias of `social`. Social accounts shown with the work: `twitter`, `mastodon`, and the like.

python.description: Which Python namespace this document's code cells run in: `shared` (the default), `isolated` for one of its own, or any name for a namespace shared by the documents that give the same one.

language.description: The dictionary the spell checker uses, as a language tag -- `fr`, `en-GB`.

shortCaptions.description: How a short caption is derived for the lists of figures and tables when a figure declares none: `sentence`, or a number of characters (10 or more). `false` prints captions in full.

citation-style.description: How a citation is rendered in the text: `author-year`, or `numeric` (the default).

citation-template.description: How one entry of the bibliography is rendered. A pattern over the fields of the entry: `{authors} ({year}). *{title}*. {container}{volume}{pages}.{doilink}`.

css.description: A style sheet, relative to the document, applied to the preview and to the exports.

slides.description: How this document is cut into slides and how a deck is drawn.

cutAtHeading.description: Start a new slide at every heading of this level or above.

fontSize.description: Base type size of a slide, in pixels. A slide is read from the back of a room.

cellFontSize.description: Type size of the code cells on a slide.

padding.description: Inner margin of a slide, as a CSS length.

verticalAlign.description: Where the content sits in the slide box.

transition.description: How one slide gives way to the next.

transitionMs.description: How long that takes, in milliseconds.

background.description: Slide background, as a CSS colour.

header.description: Header line. Three parts separated by `|`.

footer.description: Footer line. Three parts separated by `|`.

headerStyle.description: CSS applied to the header line.

footerStyle.description: CSS applied to the footer line.
